data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation was experienced during the year in respect of the following classes of business: Motor (third party liability) 6,177 (4,856) Reinsurance inwards (47) Total 1,274
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 260 reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 1.274 million in 2014, representing a 1.49% reduction of its opening gross reserves. This was a mixed development, with favourable run-off on Motor (third party liability) being partially offset by adverse development on Motor (other classes) and Reinsurance inwards. The overall net release was driven by improvements in 2012 and prior underwriting years, which offset a deterioration in the 2013 year of account due to two large incurred claims and a general increase in attritional claims.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation was experienced during the year
The 2013 year of account suffered a deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims during the year and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims.
This offset some improvements in 2012 and prior underwriting years.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was available. The 'Motor' LOB movements are split into 'Motor (third party liability)' and 'Motor (other classes)' in the source document, which are both mapped to 'Motor' in the lob_movements array.
